sample_unit: adaptation configurations (10 techniques x budgets x 3 backbones)
models_evaluated: dental radiograph foundation models (three backbones, unnamed)

links.outcome: Cross-center performance of dental diagnosis models on target center (ADCD) after training on DENTEX
links.effect: Caries AUC stays near chance after adaptation (0.60 cross-center vs 0.79 from target's own labels); impacted teeth AUC 0.71 to 0.92 after adaptation.
links.quote: Foundation models for dental radiograph diagnosis degrade at clinical centers other than the one they were trained on.

links.outcome: Recovery of target-center performance through local adaptation/fine-tuning across ten techniques
links.effect: Adaptation recovered structural pathology (impacted teeth AUC 0.71 to 0.92) but not texture pathology (caries near chance), independent of technique, budget, or backbone.
links.quote: Adaptation recovers structural pathology strongly (impacted teeth, AUC 0.71 to 0.92) but not texture pathology (caries stays near chance), independently of technique, budget, or backbone.

links.outcome: Whether an out-of-distribution gate refuses inputs from an unseen center instead of predicting unreliably
links.effect: Mahalanobis OOD gate over frozen embeddings acts as a directional shift detector; a gate re-fit on the target defers about five percent there regardless of technique; guarantee never breaks across 126 configurations.
links.quote: The refusal gate is a directional distribution-shift detector—a gate re-fit on the target defers about five percent there regardless of technique—so refusal reflects calibration, not adaptation strength.

unlisted_practices: Mahalanobis out-of-distribution refusal gate with calibration and bounded-deviation guarantee
Parameter-efficient adaptation with few labeled samples for cross-center transfer

screen.practice: safety envelope with OOD refusal gate and local adaptation
screen.reason: The study tests deployment safeguards (an out-of-distribution refusal gate/safety envelope and various local adaptation/recalibration strategies) to prevent silent failure when deploying dental AI to a new center.
